messages:
maya: CI red on master. serve_test::inflight_retries failing intermittently in latest run. job: https://ci.redwood.ai/teams/infra/runs/987654 — anyone seeing this locally?
ci-bot: build 987654 failed: serve_test::inflight_retries (timeout + assertion). Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/logs/987654
jon: @maya I saw a similar flake yesterday, might be a timing/order issue with retry queue + allocator
maya: repro: run `./scripts/test_one.sh serve_test::inflight_retries --repeat 100` — hits within ~30 runs for me
maya: failing assert:
```
assert_eq!(alloc_count, expected_allocs, "unexpected allocator calls: {} vs {}", alloc_count, expected_allocs);
```
sam: can you dump the test's time source? we still have non-deterministic timers in CI
li: adding to that — if retries are scheduled using system clock + small jitter the order can flip under load
jon: quick triage idea: add deterministic fake-clock in test harness or pin jitter seed via env
maya: tried setting FORCE_DETER_CLOCK=1 locally, reduced failures but not eliminated
sam: ok can you capture a full repro trace? set RUST_LOG=runtime=trace and upload
maya: uploaded trace: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/trace/serve_inflight_987654.txt — tags: alloc=3, retry_order=[A,C,B]
jon: looks like path where retry for B is delayed by I/O and allocator call for C happens in between
sam: @jon do you have time to run a quick git bisect? if it's behavioral change recently
jon: will start bisect now, ping back with first bad commit
ci-bot: rerun requested by maya — requeued build 987655
maya: thx :pray: if bisect points to scheduler change we can rollback rapid fix
li: also propose adding an assert in scheduler test to ensure FIFO ordering under equal priority — helps catch regressions
maya: filing a short PR with deterministic clock and extra logging, will mark flaky as quarantined if it reproduces
jon: update: bisect found first bad at 7a9c3f2 — scheduler: change to retry coalescing. investigating
sam: awesome, @jon can you link PR/commit when you have it
maya: will follow up with a minimal test and assign reviewers
li: +1 on quarantine meanwhile
maya: thanks all, keeping thread here
